# Thunderbird Mail Account Setup Interface

## System Interface

### Top Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Thunderbird Mail" application title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 23:40"
  - System status icons including:
    - Network indicator (with dropdown menu)
    - Sound icon (with volume slider)
    - Power button (with dropdown menu)

### System Menu (Dropdown)
- **Network Status**: "Wired Connected" with right arrow
- **Power Management**: "Balanced" with right arrow
- **Settings**: Gear icon
- **Lock**: Lock icon
- **Power Off / Log Out**: Power icon with right arrow

## Application Window

### Window Controls
- **Top Left**: Folder icon
- **Top Center**: Tab bar with "Account Setup" (active) and "Thunderbird Privacy Notice" (inactive)
- **Top Right**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons

### Main Content Area

#### Title
- "Set Up Your Existing Email Address"

#### Subtitle
- "To use your current email address fill in your credentials. Thunderbird will automatically search for a working and recommended server configuration."

#### Form Fields
- **Your full name**
  - Input field with placeholder text "John Doe"
  - Information icon (i) on the right
- **Email address**
  - Input field with placeholder text "john.doe@example.com"
  - Information icon (i) on the right
  - Link: "Get a new email address" (blue, underlined)
- **Password**
  - Input field (empty)
  - "Remember password" checkbox (checked)
- **Action Buttons**
  - "Cancel" button (gray)
  - "Continue" button (blue)

#### Footer Text
- "Your credentials will only be stored locally on your computer."

#### Illustration
- Blue octopus character holding various tools (megaphone, wrench, scissors, etc.)

## Desktop Environment

### Left Sidebar (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail (active)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

### Bottom Panel
- **Left**: "Done" status indicator
- **Right**: Zoom controls and "100%" scale indicator

## Additional UI Elements

### Right Sidebar (Thunderbird Mail)
- **Top**: Text formatting toolbar (bold, italic, underline, alignment options)
- **Bottom**: Scroll bar

### System Tray
- **Right Side**: System icons including:
  - Network
  - Sound
  - Power

### Status Bar
- **Bottom**: "Done" status indicator

## Visual Design

### Colors
- Primary: White background
- Secondary: Light gray for buttons and form fields
- Accent: Blue for "Continue" button and links
- Text: Black for main content, gray for secondary text

### Icons
- Information icon (i) next to input fields
- Gear icon for Settings
- Lock icon for Lock
- Power icon for Power Off / Log Out
- Folder icon for navigation
- Megaphone, wrench, scissors, etc. for illustration

### Layout
- Left-aligned form fields
- Centered illustration
- Bottom-aligned action buttons
- Right-aligned system menu

### Typography
- Headings: Bold, larger font
- Body text: Standard font size
- Links: Blue, underlined
- Buttons: Clear, distinct styling

### Interaction Elements
- Checkboxes
- Input fields
- Buttons
- Dropdown menus
- Tooltips (indicated by information icons)
- Scroll bars

### Accessibility
- Clear labels for form fields
- High contrast between text and background
- Logical layout for form completion
- Visual cues for interactive elements

### Security Indicators
- "Your credentials will only be stored locally on your computer." message
- "Remember password" checkbox
- "Get a new email address" link for alternative setup

### Branding
- Thunderbird Mail application title
- Octopus illustration representing the Thunderbird brand
- System icons consistent with Linux desktop environment

### Status Indicators
- "Done" status at bottom left
- System status icons in top bar
- Network status in dropdown menu
- Power status in dropdown menu

### Navigation
- Tab bar for switching between "Account Setup" and "Thunderbird Privacy Notice"
- System menu for accessing system settings
- Application launcher sidebar for accessing other applications

### Functional Elements
- Form fields for entering credentials
- Buttons for canceling or continuing setup
- Information icons for help or additional details
- System controls for managing audio, network,
